distributed_system.composition:
flowchart TB
    subgraph Ingress ["Ingress Boundary"]
        Client(["Client"])
        APIGateway["APIGateway"]
        AuthService["AuthService"]
    end
    subgraph Core ["Core Services"]
        OrderService["OrderService"]
        InventoryService["InventoryService"]
        Cache[("Cache")]
        MainDB[("MainDB")]
    end
    PaymentGateway{{"PaymentGateway"}}
    Client -->|"POST /orders"| APIGateway
    APIGateway -->|"verify token"| AuthService
    APIGateway -->|"forward order"| OrderService
    OrderService -->|"check stock cache"| Cache
    OrderService -->|"charge card"| PaymentGateway
    OrderService -.->|"decrement stock"| InventoryService
    OrderService -->|"save order"| MainDB
    InventoryService -->|"update inventory"| MainDB

sequence_diagram.composition:
sequenceDiagram
    participant User
    participant Client
    participant API
    participant AuthServer
    User->>Client: Click Login
    Client->>API: POST /login
    API->>AuthServer: Validate Credentials
    AuthServer-->>API: Token Issued
    API-->>Client: 200 OK

state_diagram.composition:
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Pending
    Pending --> Processing : payment_received
    Processing --> Completed : fulfilled
    Processing --> Failed : error
    Failed --> Pending : retry
    Completed --> [*]

Init ==
    /\ state = "Pending"
    /\ queue = <<>>

Next ==
    \/ /\ state = "Pending"
       /\ state' = "Processing"
       /\ UNCHANGED queue
    \/ /\ state = "Processing"
       /\ state' = "Completed"
       /\ UNCHANGED queue

TypeInvariant ==
    state \in {"Pending", "Processing", "Completed"}
